page.layout: One page of text: decorative woodcut ornament at top, then a centred title in capitals, followed by a list of numbered entries with roman numerals in the body. No margin notes. A blue library stamp at left is ignored.

main_text.head: INDEX EORVM, QVÆ HOC IN OPERE CONTINENTVR.
main_text.l: I. Ipse Iustini textus cum singulorum librorum breuiariis,& notis marginalibus.
III. Prologi veteris cuiusdam Anonymi in omnesIustini libros,cum notis eiusdem Bongarsii.
IV. Exceptiones chronologicæ ad Iustini historias accommodatæ.
V. Variarum lectionum liber, eodem auctore.
VI. In decem libros anteriores scholia Theophili Cangiseri Saxohalensis.
VII. Prolixior in Iustinum commentarius Victorini Strigelii.

page.notes: The stamp overlapping entries IV–VI is ignored. Some letters under the stamp (IV, V, VI) are partly obscured but read as printed. The ornament is a woodcut border, not transcribed.
